root_cause: During W4 CP-close, LedgerRow was extended to support ThinkLab objective admissions (Doc 05 §A5 semantics) but the frozen `northena_ledger_row.contract_snapshot.json` was not bumped in the same commit. The test was silently failing at W4 close but was not in the '264/264 gating tests' cohort the close report cited — a scoping gap in the W4 close cohort. Discovered mid-W5 (during CP2 baseline check) and honestly ledgered at W5 close rather than papered over.

reconciliation.rationale: The extensions represent intended W4 behavior. Reverting would break the live ThinkLab feature (which is on record and green at 194/194 wave-close cohort at W5 CLOSE). The Owner ruling of 'W6 GO' opener #2 IS the explicit ratification moment for the frozen-contract bump.
reconciliation.alternative_rejected_because: would break the ThinkLab admit surface live on programme/track-a HEAD

tests_first_receipt.green_after_fix: run of tests/invariants/test_northena_ledger_row_v0.py post-snapshot-bump — banked in wave-close cohort at 20260825T205000Z (see below)

verification.downstream_impact_check: no downstream code path was reading from the frozen v0 snapshot at runtime — the snapshot is a test-time invariant only; no runtime behaviour changes.

process_finding: The W4 close report's '264/264 gating tests' cohort did NOT include test_northena_ledger_row_v0.py. Recommend future wave-close cohorts assemble by grep pattern `test_*_frozen*.py` and `test_*_contract*.py` to catch every snapshot invariant. Not owner-facing binding — a discipline note for the assessment workspace.
